name: CBC BOP append-only publication-vintage revision receipt
purpose: Preserve each published CBC balance-of-payments value as a versioned observation instead of overwriting history with the latest revised value.
lineageRules: Append a new receipt for every distinct publication vintage; never overwrite a prior value.
A later revised value cannot be backfilled into any earlier selection or event timestamp.
Revision delta is computed only between two explicit receipts for the same series/reference period.
Revision direction need not be monotonic; preserve the full path.
A current database value without immutable vintage identity cannot establish historical first-known timing.
Aggregate/cumulative differences cannot allocate a revision to a component quarter without native component evidence.
Missing or inaccessible native evidence remains UNKNOWN.

currentWitness.exact37201FirstPublicBound: (2026-05-20, 2026-08-20] unless more granular official vintage evidence is obtained

exactNext: Use this schema for future CBC BOP prospective receipts.
Do not spend research effort narrowing historical first-public time unless it changes a planned validation design.
Test any future revision-state hypothesis only after enough independent publication dates exist and after rates/USD/global/Taiwan baselines.
